results.reason: The agenda lists The Views at Westley Lake as a “Preliminary & Final Major Site Plan” in the “Waterfront Redevelopment Area.”
The cited filing states that STHO, using “we,” is the managing member of Asbury Partners, LLC, which is identified as the joint venture owning the Asbury Park Waterfront investment.
The cited filing directly reports an aggregate carrying value of approximately $120.9 million as of June 30, 2026.

The cited filing directly describes the current strategy as managing operating assets, monetizing remaining development sites and operating assets through sales to third-party developers and operators, and meeting redevelopment agreement obligations.
